candidate.summary: I build reliable Java and AWS systems at scale, and tools for AI coding agents. My best work is multi-region disaster recovery and performance on a high-traffic platform, plus merged open source in ServiceTalk, CoreNLP and Arcade Agent.

projects.name: Multi-region disaster recovery on AWS (John Deere, 2026)
projects.role: Engineer; implemented the equipment platform part of a team program
projects.summary: Aurora Global Database with AWS Advanced JDBC Wrapper failover, switchover scripts and AWS FIS fault tests. Cross-region SQS listener takeover in a shared library used by two services. Transaction-aware failover retry for safe reads. Valkey global datastore, Route 53 health checks and latency routing, blue/green deploys with rollback gates. Three services run in a second AWS region. Employer code is private; the public lab shows the same pattern.

projects.name: Faster platform for connected machines (John Deere, 2025-2026)
projects.summary: Platform for connected machines. I made performance a continuous loop: measure with OpenTelemetry and Datadog, fix the biggest cost, then add a test so it stays fixed. From Jul to Oct 2026, API p95 latency was about 43% lower while traffic grew about 34%. These gains coincided with the changes; it is monthly data, not an A/B test. In 2024 I built the satellite registration flow for the Deere x SpaceX Starlink integration. Employer code and dashboards are private.
highlights: OpenTelemetry traces show where each API request spends its time, across database, cache and queue calls.
Datadog Database Monitoring shows which queries cost the most, so each cycle starts with the biggest cost.
Each fix gets a test so it cannot come back, then I check the trend the next month.
Statement-count test harness: a test fails when an endpoint runs more SQL statements than its budget.
Moved the hot authorization cache to Valkey, shared across instances instead of one per JVM.
Cached one JAXBContext per type: about 15% less CPU at fix time.
Sized the JVM heap from the task's memory limit: message service memory use went from 34% to 15%, with 23% fewer tasks.
CPU per request was about 50% lower from Jul to Oct 2026, over the same months as the p95 drop.

Each cycle I fix the biggest cost, add a test so it cannot come back (for example a statement-count budget per endpoint), and check the trend the next month.
